pages.transcription:
next address:

7 Ramapo Road
Ossining, N.Y.

Newyork, June 26th, 1941.

Dear Hanna,

We just got your letter of June 18th which is not
quite clear to us because it refers to your letter of the 13th
which has not yet arrived. I am extremely sorry that you had
to run about and to have all these discussions for us. You know
that when we left it was our intention to come back soon and I
left everything in your care, perhaps not in such perfect order
as I otherwise would have done, believing that I would soon be
back again. Owing to the enormous distances I have had no direct
mail about business matters since a long time and therefore not a
very clear idea how things stand. But I am convinced that all is
in best order and that if there have been any questinns, they have
been settled satisfactorily. Everybody's affairs are nowadays
frightfully complicated and I am sorry that I had to burden you
with ours while you have no doubt enough troubles of your own in
these difficult times. As to my publisher I am terribly sorry
that they had such a mishap, and I shall write him directly how
sorry I am. We will now go to the little country place we wrote
you about yesterday - the above address will be valid until Sept.1st
but do not address any more letters there after the first week of
August because they sometimes take three weeks - and there we will
do nothing but work hard these two summer months. After that we
shall again have to decide what to do. I have again offers from
South America for lectures in Cuba, Brazil and Argentine and so
on, but who can tell what will happen in those few months in times
like ours where every week brings new and unexpected developments.
Let me repeat how thankful we are to you and I need
not assure you again of our love and gratitude.

Yours,

Stefan Zweig

Your letter arrived in record time today - 7 days
from house to house. Your other letter has not yet come
and we are guessing what your references to the Edinburgh trip
and other things mean. But we will no doubt receive it
very soon. From next week we are near Eva, and that will
give us pleasure and you further reassurance

Love, Lotte
